For m<1 the shift is compact quasinilpotent; T_b=exp(bD). D^2H_b(D) has singular numbers O(n^(-2beta)); Ky Fan rank shifts k=floor(n^gamma), 1/2<gamma<1, yield s_n(T_b-I)~|b| c_m n^(-beta), including exact Schatten p cutoff, weak endpoint and singleton ordinary/essential spectra. For m=1, w_n=(alpha/2)sqrt(2n/(2n+1)), so D differs compactly from R times the backward shift. The Calkin circle, holomorphic factorization of exp(bz)-mu, and surjectivity of interior backward-shift factors establish the folded Fredholm curve, integer index and resonance kernel count (boundary roots are not eigenvectors). Complete matrix polynomial norm equality follows from the matrix von Neumann inequality plus the unitary Calkin image. This independently reconstructed analytic proof covers every n and m in the stated ranges; a finite check alone would not.
